WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as baseline_value
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  oi.order_id,
  AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as order_avg_quantity,
  AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) - b.baseline_value as difference
FROM Order_Items oi
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE oi.product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  AND b.baseline_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY oi.order_id, b.baseline_value
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10
